definitions.gloss: we, our side, this party, the undersigned
definitions.explanation: A formal first-person pronoun referring to oneself or one's organization. Used in business correspondence, legal documents, and official communications. More impersonal than 私たち.

examples.japanese: {当方|とうほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{了承|りょうしょう}しました→了承する：20062_ryoushousuru⟧。
{当方|とうほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{落|お}ち⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ございませ→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧ん。
examples.english: There is no fault on our part.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございましたら→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧、{当方|とうほう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have any questions, please contact us.

notes:
{当方|とうほう} is a formal pronoun used in business and official contexts to refer to oneself or one's organization.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当方|とうほう}: formal, impersonal; used in business letters and legal contexts
- ⟦{私|わたくし}ども→私ども：22787_watakushidomo⟧: humble form of "we"; polite business speech
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: our company (humble); specifically for companies
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧: our company (neutral); less humble than ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧
- ⟦{先方|せんぽう}→先方：20241_senpou⟧: the other party, their side
- {相手方|あいてがた}: the other party (legal)

REGISTER:
Strictly formal and written. Not used in everyday conversation.
